Messages.Author: Goratrux
Messages.Body:
In the text below does "second action" actually mean "subsequent" ? What
if the acting minion was playing its second action? May it play a third
one without restriction?

Same question, under NRA rules.

----------------
Change of Target
Action Modifier
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked. Untap the acting
{minion, do not tap the blocking minion}, and cancel the current action
and combat. If you do a second action with this minion this turn, it
cannot be the same action.
----------------

--Gor
